question: How many vehicles were in force at the end of the second quarter of 2025?
final_text:
There were 36,722 vehicles in force at 30 June 2025. I counted exposure units from premium transactions that were booked on or before 30 June 2025. The cover had to start on or before that date and end after it. Cancellations carry −1, so they are netted off.

A simpler count of policy terms on cover on that date gives 36,701. It excludes 21 terms whose cancellation date falls on or before 30 June. I assume those cancellations were booked after 30 June, so the as-at rule leaves them out of my figure. I did not check those 21 cancellation rows. I used 36,722 because it follows the as-at rule of using only what was booked by the valuation date.

ANSWER: 36722

input.query:
select (select count(*) from policy_term where bound_date<='2025-06-30' and inception_date<='2025-06-30' and expiry_date>'2025-06-30' and (cancel_date is null or cancel_date>'2025-06-30')) a,
(select sum(exposure_units) from premium_txn where booked_date<='2025-06-30' and effective_date<='2025-06-30' and cover_end_date>'2025-06-30') b
